name: Ghenh Rang
kicker: Egg stones and the queen’s cove
summary: Egg-stone cove about 3 km southeast: walk the rounded rocks free for about an hour on the south coast. The stones are sea-smoothed and egg-shaped, on the shore called bãi tắm Hoàng Hậu after Nam Phương Hoàng Hậu. Walk on to Hàn Mặc Tử’s grave on the hillside. Bãi Xếp, 13 km south, is its own fishing village.
getThere: About 3 km southeast of the center.
heroCaption: Egg-shaped stones along the water at Ghềnh Ráng

notice.title: Ask for bãi tắm Hoàng Hậu
notice.body: The queen’s shore on this rock coast is bãi tắm Hoàng Hậu. Bãi Xếp lies 13 km south, in its own fishing village.

body: Follow the path along the hill and walk the egg stones, the Vọng Phu rock, the lion-shaped rock, and bãi tắm Tiên Sa. Nam Phương Hoàng Hậu used this cove, which is why the shore is called bãi tắm Hoàng Hậu. Bảo Đại chose Ghềnh Ráng as a royal retreat from 1927.

Hàn Mặc Tử’s grave is on the hillside. From there you see the east of the city and Phuong Mai. The area is about 3 km southeast of the center, in Phường Quy Nhơn Nam. The visit is free, and the hours run from 7:00 to 18:00.

figures.caption: Hàn Mặc Tử’s monument on the hillside, full figure
figures.alt: The white figure of Hàn Mặc Tử on a stone pedestal above the grave at Ghềnh Ráng

gettingThere: Ghềnh Ráng is about 3 km southeast of the center, in Phường Quy Nhơn Nam. The stone church stands opposite the grave, under the hill.
Bãi Xếp is 13 km south on the Quy Nhơn–Sông Cầu road, quốc lộ 1D.

legs.heading: From the center
legs.body: About 3 km southeast, into Phường Quy Nhơn Nam.
